activityPolicies.policyname: Admins can read all user activity

cause.identity: Original Auth trigger casts unsupported partner_operations_manager to user_role, catches the enum error and provisions Rider. Signup trigger creates zero balance; later Partner membership did not remove it.
cause.uncertainty: Original HTTP provisioning failure/response is unavailable. Current reservations contain no journal for this historical identity.
cause.lastActive: Account subject user_id was treated as actor activity; missing existing session projection, legacy public timestamp substitution and Never on unavailable compounded the defect.

activityDefinition: Maximum reliable recorded Auth sign-in, UTC Auth token refresh, existing authenticated Admin session touch and non-system activity attributed to actor_user_id. Automatic refresh is session activity, not proof of human interaction. Logout preserves the prior recorded timestamp, not deletion time. Account creation, subject edits, arbitrary updated_at and legacy public fields are excluded.
changes: Remove managed Product server_assigned_role metadata writer; durable reservations remain authoritative.
Add bounded service-only activity RPC with account authority checks and session-delete retention; no new heartbeat or per-request writes.
Users uses only the canonical activity projection, explicit unavailable/null states and instant-based sorting before pagination.
Prepare exact fail-closed one-identity correction with Owner/history preservation and whole-database/other-account fingerprint assertions.

full.skippedReason: Eight optional User Details PostgREST checks and one optional Users PostgREST handler check require their separate HTTP flags; existing concurrent User Details release evidence covers its flow.

checks.postgres: Real local PostgreSQL 17. Activity timestamps/ACLs/future/system/null/session-deletion behavior; exact correction dependency/balance/schema refusal, Owner/history preservation, Rider-only denial, cross-organisation denial and replay. Existing suites cover domain provisioning, Mobile signup, legitimate multi-domain accounts, MFA, RLS and revocation.
checks.auth: Real local GoTrue v2.197.0: successful password login, token exchange and logout; existing real Auth provisioning checks all account domains, recovery and no accidental Rider.
checks.ui: Actual TanStack sorting/pagination and React rendering: offset timestamps, unknown-last both directions, relative-time changes, unavailable versus no recorded activity. Users handler verifies domain filters, stale Rider enum ignored, bounded projections and refresh.

reducedCapHttp.details: Final JSON-returning RPC verified through actual PostgREST at a 37-row cap: 1,213 Users, no activity warnings, correct known/null timestamps; no RPC row truncation. Includes final real GoTrue login/refresh/logout and SQL ACL checks.

checks.initialEnvironmentFailures: Default five-second tests timed out under shared resource load; later shared PostgreSQL port 55443 disappeared with its owning task. Task-owned replacement plus 15-second limits produced final full pass. No test assertions weakened.
